canon_ref.note: Night 7, the night after 1.10. No rumor: news of it does not reach Liscor in these chapters.

b1.great_ritual_summoning.summary: Deep under the Blighted Kingdom, a [High Mage] ends a decades-long ritual before the Blighted King and Queen. Young Humans from Earth appear, hailed as heroes of prophecy. Many more land alone all over the world: a farm, a Runner's Guild, a throne room, a tomb, a forest.
